# CANDIDATE: VIX_FILTER_BEARISH_REJECTION

**Filed:** 2026-09-16  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** filter_change  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Adding a VIX >= 20 filter to the BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON setup will exclude low-VIX losing days (e.g., 5/05, 5/06, 5/07) while preserving high-VIX winner days (4/29, 5/01, 5/04). This aims to increase edge_capture by avoiding losses on days where options premium is insufficient to sustain moves.

## Mechanism

Entry trigger: BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON (unchanged).  
Pre-entry filter: require the VIX value (from the same timestamp as the entry bar) to be greater than or equal to 20.  
Exit logic: unchanged (chart stop at rejected level + $0.50 buffer, chandelier profit-lock arming at +5% and trailing 15%, premium stop at -50% catastrophe cap, time stop at 15:50 ET).  
Position sizing and contract selection remain as defined in the playbook for BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+ account; $1K paper account approximates 14% of headline P&L (risk-per-trade 50% of equity, 3-contract minimum scales to 28 contracts at $25K).  
2. **Sample bias:** Sample size = 0 (pre-backtest). Selection method = N/A. Overfit risk = high if VIX threshold is tuned to J days without OOS validation; will mitigate by using fixed threshold (20) derived from bearish setup context filters.  
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (walk-forward held-out window not yet performed).  
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (real OPRA bid/ask validation on top 3 J days not yet performed).  
5. **Failure modes:**  
   - Worst day: if a winner day (e.g., 4/29) has VIX < 20, the filter would skip the trade, turning a large winner into a zero, reducing edge_capture.  
   - Max drawdown: could exceed historical max if multiple winner days are filtered out while losers remain unfiltered (if losers occur on high-VIX days).  
   - Blow-up scenario: persistent high-VIX regime with choppy price action could generate many small losses, eroding equity if the filter admits low-quality setups.  
6. **Concentration:** unknown -- requires Stage-1 backtest (will compute top-5 days % of P&L after backtest).

## Pre-merge gate

- Gym validators: all relevant unit tests must pass (e.g., test_vix_filter_*.py).  
- Walk-forward: OOS/IS Sharpe ratio >= 0.70 on walk-forward window.  
- Real-fills: real OPRA fill simulation on top 3 J days must show <20% deviation from BS-sim P&L.  
- Anchor no-regression: must not reduce edge_capture on any J winner day below current engine behavior (to be measured).  
- A/B scorecard filed in analysis/recommendations/.
